hero.subtitle: Fast payouts, dedicated support and projects your clients will love.

policies.a: A client is tagged to you when you register them through the CP desk before their first site visit. The tag stays valid for 60 days from the visit.
The visit counts when your client visits with you or with your CP code, and signs the visit register at the site.
Brokerage is released after registration of the agreement for sale and receipt of 10% of the agreement value.
All partners must hold a valid MahaRERA agent registration. Payouts are made only to registered agents.

faqs.q: Who can become a channel partner?
faqs.a: Any individual or firm with a valid MahaRERA agent registration.
Usually 3–5 working days after document verification.
